name: Second Chance
source:
If you were given a second chance, will you take it?

Wake up in a strange place and in a new body. You now have to help a strange wolf gather the three heroes of prophecy to save his world from a terrible fate.

[From [url=https://frory17.itch.io/second-chance]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果给你第二次机会，你会接受吗？

在一个陌生的地方和一个新的身体中醒来。你现在必须帮助一只奇怪的狼聚集三位预言英雄，以拯救他的世界免遭可怕的命运。

[来自[url=https://frory17.itch.io/second-chance]Itch.io[/url]]
